errors.text: The hypothesis predicts a surge in dislocation density at wear instability, whereas the target reports a significant reduction in dislocation density at 900–1200 K as rapid lattice disorder develops.
It does not identify the required critical threshold of 900 K, instead speculating about an approximately 800–840 K spinodal temperature.
Spinodal decomposition, collapse of short-range order, and amorphous-like transformation are introduced without evidence for this FeNiCrCoCu/Cu system.
The cited evidence concerns different alloy systems and does not validate the proposed temperature-dependent defect evolution in FeNiCrCoCu.
